events.summary: Lola dreams of her reflection pulling her into its maw.
events.quote: her reflection pulled her into its gaping maw.

events.summary: When cultists attack, Warnis's latent potential becomes a torrent of power.
events.quote: That night, as the cultists attacked, it became a torrent of power that was hers to command.

events.summary: Sarevok's deception is unmasked and the crowd turns into an outraged mob.
events.quote: When Sarevok's deception was unmasked, the cheering crowd erupted into an outraged mob.

events.summary: The kobold Pozo is killed by elven steel.
events.quote: Pozo's heart was full of courage, right up until it was full of elven steel.

events.summary: Quenton is trapped by a mirror as reality collapses around him.
events.quote: Quenton barely had a second to admire his exquisite handsomeness before reality collapsed around him.

events.summary: Gale sees an uncanny stranger instead of himself in a pool.
events.quote: Gale stared into the pool and saw a stranger.

events.summary: Marsden dies shouting at his party to spread out.
events.quote: "Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!" —Marsden, party leader, last words

events.summary: Urabrask decrees that the arriving Mirran resistance be left alone.
events.quote: His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

events.summary: Liliana urges Oketra and Bontu to turn on the usurper.
events.quote: "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

events.summary: Ellwen vanishes from a locked chamber overnight.
events.quote: By morning, the fire was out and Ellwen was gone.

events.summary: Ugin tells Jace the Eldrazi can be imprisoned with hedrons; Jace is skeptical.
events.quote: "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned." "And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

relations.quote: It will make your stolen godhood no less false.

rejected.summary: Sunlight shines again on the long-lost towers of Elturel amid smoke and rubble.
rejected.quote: sunlight shining on the long-lost towers of Elturel was still a beautiful sight.

rejected.summary: The demons of Immersturm invade Bretagard.
rejected.quote: Panic spread like wildfire as the demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.

rejected.note: Seeks to regain his lost immortality.
rejected.quote: There is no line Jon Irenicus would not cross to regain his lost immortality.
Under Drana's leadership, vampires are finding new strength in unity.
